Features

MTL Explorer keeps your GPS tracks, photos, videos, and optional health data on your own server. This list describes the version in development; see the released guides for older versions.

Topic What you can do Guide
Import Upload files or copy them into a folder; GPX, FIT, and six other formats; optional Garmin download; files added while the server was off are picked up Import tracks
Map See all your tracks on one map; click any spot to see tracks, photos, places, and public trails there; choose base maps, trail and place layers, and a heatmap Map
Filters Choose tracks by date, activity, and other criteria; group and color them; write your own filters in SQL Filters
Tracks Search and sort your tracks; see summaries, graphs, related tracks, data quality, photos, breaks and GPS gaps; download the original file Tracks
Review Check files with problems, look at the original GPS points, fix files in another tool, and choose whether a track counts on the map, in statistics, or both Review
Statistics Totals, activity types, highlights, trends over time, photo counts, milestones, and the tracks behind each number Statistics
Energy and motion Estimated calories, work, and power; training load; moving, stopped, and unknown time; breaks Analysis
Exploration See how much of an activity was new ground compared with your earlier tracks Milestones and exploration
Segments Mark a stretch with checkpoints, find every time you passed it, and compare or replay your attempts, including heart rate Segment discovery, comparison
Replay Replay one activity in 3D, race several attempts, or animate your archive over time Replay
Planning Plan routes on the map with live distance, climb, and elevation; undo and redo; save plans and places; export GPX Planning
Media Browse photos by map, activity, or period; full-screen viewer; download originals; correct camera time; set locations; play videos, converting them when your browser needs it Photos and videos
Health Optional read-only copy of your Google Health data: trends, records, exercise routes, and heart rate on tracks Health
Preferences Theme, date and number format, units, and signing out with or without clearing local data Settings
Mobile and offline Use it on your phone, show your position, install it as an app, and view already loaded tracks and maps offline Mobile and offline
Administration Data folders, import progress, rescans, logs, component versions, update checks, backups, and updates Administration, Logs
On this page
  • Limits
  • Demo

Limits

  • MTL Explorer can't add data your files don't have, such as missing timestamps or elevation.
  • Energy and exploration are estimates.
  • Duplicates, and tracks excluded from statistics in Review, don't count there.
  • Route planning needs downloaded routing data. Online maps, 3D terrain, and trail layers need the internet.
  • Offline, you only see what this browser already loaded. MTL Explorer does not record activities.
  • Google Health is in beta and needs your own Google API access. Its dates are separate from the track filter.
  • Photo counts follow the time span of your filtered tracks and the All media / Track related choice.

Demo

The public demo uses public Porto taxi tracks and generated data. Its health data is made up. You can't connect a Google account in the demo.

For how things work inside, see Architecture. For building and testing, see Development.
